name: kaying-for-ui

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: 游戏界面设计UI设计-咖影

description: Game UI design and handoff workflow: from GDD/PRD and design specs to screen extension, component breakdown, sprite slicing, atlas packing, and Godot/Unity/Cocos JSON handoff.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 游戏 UI 设计与交付全流程：从 GDD/PRD、风格契约、页面视觉到组件拆解、切图、图集打包与 Godot/Unity/Cocos 引擎 JSON 交付；零依赖 Node CLI，开箱即用。
description_i18n.en: Game UI design and handoff workflow: from GDD/PRD and design specs to screen extension, component breakdown, sprite slicing, atlas packing, and Godot/Unity/Cocos JSON handoff. Zero-dependency Node CLI.

examplePrompts: 用咖影根据参考图为一个国风卡牌 RPG 搭建完整 UI 项目：先完成策划与设计规格，再生成主界面视觉
把这张主界面拆成透明底组件，然后切雪碧图为单张 PNG 并打包图集
Generate 9-slice, atlas, and Unity/Godot handoff JSON

requires: node>=18 (bundled with the host; nothing to install)

notes_i18n.zh-CN: 将 bundled/kaying-for-ui/<宿主> 目录放到本机稳定路径，在宿主的「插件市场 → 新增」中注册为本地源后安装启用；不要注册远程 URL。
notes_i18n.en: Copy bundled/kaying-for-ui/<host> to a stable local path, register that directory as a local marketplace source in the host, then install and enable the plugin. Do not register a remote URL.
